name: Dire Maul: Magister Kalendris never dominates a player who fights him alone (#13210)
contract: Issue #13210. Magister Kalendris 11487 is a Dire Maul (map 429, expansion 0) encounter boss (instance_encounters
348). His SmartAI casts Dominate Mind 7645 at a random non-top-threat target (event 4, first after 14-20 s, then
every 30 s) and the Ascension kit's Dominate Mind 2100244 at a random player (event 9000, first after 16.1-18.1 s,
then every 30-32 s). Both carry SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM on effect 0 (server Spell.dbc). The vanilla dungeon boss rule
only spares tanks and healers, so a lone damage dealer was dominated, left Kalendris with nobody to fight and
reset him. The maintainer decided his Dominate must not reset him: BossControlTargeting.h now forbids his charms
while fewer than two players are on his threat list, and keeps the tank and healer rule otherwise.
The two rogues (no tank or healer specialization) group in Stormwind; only 'solo' enters at the East Wing
[East] entrance (areatrigger 3185, no hostile spawn within 50 yd). Kalendris is summoned 3 yd to the east,
'solo' engages him for 3 s and then holds his attention for 42 s: at least one window of each event. Neither
charm may be applied and Kalendris must stay in combat. Then 'partner' joins the threat list and Kalendris must
apply the kit's Dominate Mind within 75 s (two event 9000 windows), which proves the solo silence comes from the
lone-player rule and not from a broken timer. Player health fixtures keep both alive.

steps.label: Let the characters finish logging in
CONTROL: solo is inside the dungeon
CONTROL: partner stays outside the dungeon
Summon the boss in the group's instance
Let the boss's spawn events settle
Both Dominate Mind windows pass while solo fights alone
Kalendris did not reset: he is still fighting solo
Kalendris never applied the kit's Dominate Mind while one player fought him
Kalendris never applied Dominate Mind 7645 while one player fought him
CONTROL: partner is inside the dungeon
With two players engaged, Kalendris dominates again
